description: Overview Showcase your creativity and technical skills by presenting innovative Embedded Systems, Hardware, and Software projects. Participants will have the opportunity to demonstrate their working projects and explain their unique solutions. Projects will be evaluated based on innovation, technical implementation, functionality, and presentation. Compete, innovate, and turn your ideas into impactful real-world solutions! Round 1: PPT Submission Deadline: 23rd September 2026 PPT Template: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/12vshInl3OI7wRDW8HSsieAIpIJH96SRt/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=110107193753350885256&rtpof=true&sd=true Round 2: Live Presentation: 25th September 2026, 12 PM Round 1: Online Submission (Unstop / Invente Portal) Rules: Content: Include only relevant project information and keep the presentation clear and concise. PPT Content: The presentation should include Title, Problem Statement, Objective, Working Principle/Methodology, Implementation, Novelty, and Results/Applications. Format & Deadline: Submit the PPT in PPT/PPTX format before the specified deadline on Unstop. Round 2: Live Presentation at the College Venue Rules: Participants must register through Invente Portal before the event begins. Invente Portal URL: https://www.ssnsnucinvente.com/events/project-showcase-4-0 Projects can be from the fields of Embedded Systems, Hardware, or Software. Judging Criteria: Winners will be selected based on the judges’ evaluation following the participants’ presentations. Project Demonstration: Participants are encouraged to bring physical projects and PPT attached in Round 1. If physical working project is not feasible, a clear recorded video demonstration of the working project is mandatory. For Queries Contact: Naren Kumar - 8838664792 Pranav RP - 8220727972 Sibin Paulraj - 8122719696 Email: robotics@snuchennai.edu.in Organized By, Potential: The Robotics Club of SNUC Department of CSE(SNUC)

raw.details:
Overview

Showcase your creativity and technical skills by presenting innovative Embedded Systems, Hardware, and Software projects. Participants will have the opportunity to demonstrate their working projects and explain their unique solutions. Projects will be evaluated based on innovation, technical implementation, functionality, and presentation.

Compete, innovate, and turn your ideas into impactful real-world solutions!

Round 1: PPT Submission Deadline: 23rd September 2026

PPT Template: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/12vshInl3OI7wRDW8HSsieAIpIJH96SRt/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=110107193753350885256&rtpof=true&sd=true

Round 2: Live Presentation: 25th September 2026, 12 PM

Round 1: Online Submission (Unstop / Invente Portal)

Rules:

  • Content: Include only relevant project information and keep the presentation clear and concise.
  • PPT Content: The presentation should include Title, Problem Statement, Objective, Working Principle/Methodology, Implementation, Novelty, and Results/Applications.
  • Format & Deadline: Submit the PPT in PPT/PPTX format before the specified deadline on Unstop.

Round 2: Live Presentation at the College Venue

Rules: 

  • Participants must register through Invente Portal before the event begins.
  • Invente Portal URL: https://www.ssnsnucinvente.com/events/project-showcase-4-0
  • Projects can be from the fields of Embedded Systems, Hardware, or Software.
  • Judging Criteria: Winners will be selected based on the judges’ evaluation following the participants’ presentations.
  • Project Demonstration: Participants are encouraged to bring physical projects and PPT attached in Round 1. If physical working project is not feasible, a clear recorded video demonstration of the working project is mandatory.

For Queries Contact:
Naren Kumar - 8838664792
Pranav RP - 8220727972
Sibin Paulraj - 8122719696
Email: robotics@snuchennai.edu.in

Organized By, 
Potential: The Robotics Club of SNUC 
Department of CSE(SNUC)
